name: Sour bamboo with egg
summary: Sour bamboo lifted from the jar, boiled, then stir-fried with garlic and egg, with mắc khén and dried chili.
origin: Bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn. Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019.
howToEat: From the pan. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn. A city shop was not named.
seoTitle: Mang chua xao trung in Mai Son — sour bamboo and egg
seoDescription: Măng chua xào trứng of the Muong at bản Heo, Tà Hộc, Mai Sơn. Vietnamnet boils the bamboo about 15 minutes, then fries it with egg about 5 minutes.
